This millet plot is small, and I will mostly manage it with my family because we have to watch costs. Since I am in the North West and millet can respond even to a modest amount of fertilizer, I will use a little chemical fertilizer and also some manure if I can get it. I will plant my usual local seed, not improved seed, and I do not expect to irrigate this plot because we depend on the rains. I may hire a few labor days only if I need help for weeding or land preparation.
